command:
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash
source .closed_loop_cache/install/setup.bash
export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=80 RCUTILS_COLORIZED_OUTPUT=0
/usr/bin/python3 scripts/watchdog_topic_probe.py --output /tmp/atlas_watchdog_hops.csv --duration 140 > /tmp/atlas_watchdog_hops_probe.log 2>&1 &
probe_pid=$!
bash src/atlas_obstacle_stopping_demo/scripts/run_test.sh --scenario none --results-root /tmp/atlas_watchdog_hops_runs
result=$?
wait "$probe_pid"
exit "$result"
